notes: The independent audit adds six local findings: one absent terminal point, three pale construction-stroke refinements, one omitted uncertain curly graphic inside a cancellation, and the raised placement of an existing cancelled exponent. D41 and D48 are supplied as complete revised earlier rows.

The two-dot-like form before 1 in (14) is retained as à after comparison with the same-page standalone à in the stability note, the tiling note and the cancelled NB. The lower body is broader in the stability note and narrower in the tiling note/(14); the hand variation is local evidence rather than a grammatical substitution. No forced-colon difference or new doubt is introduced.

The long external oblique and exterior return are copied as pale unlabelled construction strokes. No extra topological vertex, graph edge, arrowhead or historical order is asserted. Extending the first upper-left hatch leaves the count at six.

The newly retained curly stroke belongs physically to the cancelled du type span and is distinct from the higher/right insertion attachment. Its brace-like function remains uncertain, and no matching closer is supplied.

The old cancelled formula retains the literal first a exponent -1, the separately written inverse clusters, the sigma_1r underbrace index and the sigma_1r at the NB tail. These were not normalized by the later live formula.

The uncertain live outer exponent after the first parenthesized group remains + versus -1. Moving the separate cancelled -1 beside the beta superscript does not decide that live exponent or the mathematical stability claim.

All existing crowded-endpoint doubts in the tiling remain: filled right endpoints are not promoted to extra heads, and the short loop beside tau_1(r) receives no new cancellation or label interpretation.

H comparisons are limited to its supplied local prose and formulas. Its unavailable separate drawings are not judged for the new pencil-stroke details. The H omission of the cancelled beta exponent remains recorded, and its unrelated outer-exponent uncertainty is not conflated with that omission.
No new mathematical proof, computation or counterexample was performed in this audit. The on-page formula and stability assertions were checked as ink readings only.
Main personally reviewed the seven relevant evidence crops for the new findings and the à comparison, including the final targeted beta-placement question, and approved these readings before return.
